summary: Phase 2 dispatch 3: Deep analysis confirmed the IH-based formula is fundamentally unprovable for the forward direction. The cross-condition problem (inner witnesses vs t when both are on the same side of x) is inherent to the one-variable-at-a-time peeling approach in temporal logic. Even NF-boolean transitivity (established from satisfying assignment) does not help because the IH produces witnesses relative to x without constraining them relative to t. The correct fix: replace the succ case formula with translateEF1-based construction that handles all n+2 positions in a single Since/Until chain. Detailed implementation plan in handoff v33-phase-2-dispatch-3.md.
